content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Kenyan creators

Platforms like Stripe are often the first choice for online payments, but they come with a hefty price tag: geographic restrictions. When a creator in Kenya tries to use Stripe, they're met with a brick wall. But what if you could create an online store that doesn't depend on Stripe or any other platform? With blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you can break free from these restrictions and process international payments without hesitation. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that puts you in control of your online store and payments. By using NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, you can process payments in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This is a game-changer for Kenyan creators who want to tap into global markets without relying on restricted platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy this infrastructure, you'll need to set up a few essential tools. First, you'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your online store. Next, you'll need a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account to handle backend logic. You'll also need a Supabase or Google Sheets account to store orders and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver files. Finally, you'll need a NOWPayments account to process payments. Don't worry, these tools are free or low-cost, and you can sign up for them in minutes. The Sovereign Blueprint, a comprehensive guide to building and scaling your online store, is also a valuable resource to have on hand. For just $47, you'll get complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. It's a small price to pay for the freedom to process international payments without restrictions.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools set up, it's time to create your payment and delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. To set up your pipeline, follow these steps: create a NOWPayments account, set up your payment methods, and integrate your payment gateway with your online store. Next, set up your delivery pipeline by integrating your file delivery service with your online store. With Cloudflare R2, you can deliver files quickly and securely, and with Supabase or Google Sheets, you can store orders and customer data. By following these steps, you'll have a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline that's ready to process international payments.
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. With NOWPayments, you can [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-works-6|COREMERCH guide to start]] processing payments immediately, and with Cloudflare's edge network, you'll get fast and secure payment processing. To process your first transaction, simply create a payment request, send it to your customer, and wait for the payment to be confirmed. With NOWPayments, you'll get automatic webhook notifications when a payment is confirmed, so you can stay up to date with your transactions. This infrastructure is designed to be easy to use, so you can focus on growing your business and not worrying about payment processing.
